source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 700 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 700 was established by Ordinance No. 25742, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 22, 2004. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 700 is established on property located north of Simpson Stuart Road between Lancaster Road and Bonnie View Road. The size of PD 700 is approximately 30.212 acres. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan/Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN/DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse" must comply with the development plan portion of the conceptual plan/development plan (Exhibit 700A).

(b) A development plan that complies with this article and the conceptual plan for the portion of the Property labelled "Mixed-Use" on the conceptual plan/development plan must be submitted to the city plan commission for approval prior to the issuance of a building permit.

(c) Except as provided in this subsection, the development plan for the mixed-use tract must comply with Section 51A-4.702.

(1) Signs are only required to be shown on the development plan for the mixed-use portion of the Property.

(2) The portion of Section 51A-4.702(c) requiring submission of a development plan within six months of the city council's approval of this district does not apply.

(d) In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan/development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only uses permitted on the Property are those uses permitted in the MU-l Mixed Use District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MU-1 Mixed Use District. For example, a use permitted in the MU-1 Mixed Use District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MU-1 Mixed Use District is permitted in this district only by DIR; etc. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) In this district, the following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided below, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MU-1 Mixed Use District apply in this district.

(b) Front yard. For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," minimum front yard is as shown on the conceptual plan/development plan. A maximum six-foot-high fence is permitted in the front yard.

(c) Side and rear yard. For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," minimum side and rear yard is as shown on the conceptual plan/development plan.

(d) Density. For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," maximum number of dwelling units is 250.

(e) Floor area. For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," maximum floor area is as shown on the conceptual plan/development plan.

(f) Height.

(1) For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," maximum structure height is 36 feet.

(2) For the portion of the Property labelled "Mixed-Use," maximum structure height is 45 feet subject to any further limitations on height for the MU-1 Mixed Use District.

(g) Lot coverage.

(1) For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse,"maximum lot coverage is as shown on the conceptual plan/development plan.

(2) Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(h) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(i) Stories.

(1) For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," maximum number of stories is two.

(2) For the portion of the Property labelled "Mixed-Use," no maximum number of stories. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as modified in this section, consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Except as modified in this section, consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally.

(b) For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," parking and loading must be provided in the amount and in the locations shown on the conceptual plan/development plan, and enclosed garage parking must be provided for all dwelling units that have two or more bedrooms. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.110. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.112. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Number of dwelling units in a building. For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," a single building may have no fewer than 12, and no more than 14 dwelling units.

(b) Building spacing. For the portion of the Property labelled "Multifamily/Townhouse," a minimum of 12 feet is required between all structures.

(c) Maintenance. The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(d) Compliance with all laws. Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.113. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) Except as otherwise provided herein, all paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25742)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-700.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 700 is located on Zoning Map No. O-8. (Ord. 25742)
